g.text: Provide a single, normative registry for card types and allowed relationship
targets/verbs so models can be validated and interpreted consistently across
Export an agent-friendly compact model representation containing the cards and
their directed links in a single JSON document.
Maintain an audit log per mission that records deterministic
Model homes MUST contain the shared Aurora schemas, and missions MUST follow
the standard folder layout for cards and audit logs.
A compact, single-file representation MUST be supported for transport and agent
consumption, using the compact schema and retaining card ids, types, fields,
A canonical registry MUST define the available card types, their id acronyms,
and the allowed outgoing relationship targets and verbs for each card type.
Define Aurora (Agent-Unified Representation of Requirements and Architecture)
using Aurora itself: a deterministic, machine-consumable architecture model
rooted at a single Mission card, backed by schemas and canonical registries,
and usable by tools and agents.
Models must use the standard Aurora folder layout: Mission card at model home,
mission-scoped cards under `<MISSION_ID>/<Card Type>/`, and an audit log at
Maintain the canonical registries (card definitions and view definitions) that
govern model validation and view generation.
Starting from the Mission, all links MUST traverse away from the Mission; every
card must be reachable; and traversal must terminate in a leaf or a previously
Enable tools to generate consistent diagrams and documentation from the model
without manually drawing or maintaining multiple sources of truth.
Eliminate ambiguous architectural meaning by enforcing invariant rules and
schema-backed cards so that any interpretation (views, traceability, impact
The Mission card serves as the root of the model graph and must only have
Rendering MUST treat canonical registry style fields (shape/icon/fill/color) as
non-normative hints; model validity MUST depend on normative fields (types,
Humans and automation (LLMs, agents, validation/render tooling) that need a
shared, unambiguous representation of architecture and requirements.
Generate view artifacts from the model by selecting roots and included card
types, traversing reachable subgraphs, and rendering diagrams without changing
Validate that an Aurora model conforms to schemas, canonical registries, and
graph invariants (reachability, root direction, and no-orphan rules).
View definitions MUST specify root card types and included card types; view
roots MUST exclude cards participating in cycles (root safety rule).
Every non-Mission card must have one or more incoming links and be reachable
Cards MUST conform to the Aurora card schema (required fields, identifier
format, and link structure) and be stored as pretty-printed JSON.
Each mission MUST have an audit log recording create/change/delete events with
timestamp, editor, target id, and change type.
A model MUST include exactly one Mission card as the root intent, with only
outgoing links, summarizing the high-level why of the model.
Default tooling SHOULD validate models, generate human-readable outputs,
generate views, and export compact models from the source cards.
